item.description: Deutschland schneidet bei Bildungsstudie PISA so schlecht wie nie zuvor ab, Auftakt der Haushaltswoche im Bundestag, Landes-CDU stellt sich nach Wahlschlappe in Sachsen-Anhalt neu auf, Experten befürchten Abschreckung von Investoren und Personal im Falle einer Landesregierung unter AfD-Führung in Sachsen-Anhalt, Nach dreitägiger Feuerpause erneut russische Angriffe auf die Ukraine, Festnahme des Tatverdächtigen nach mehreren Sabotage-Anschlägen auf das deutsche Stromnetz, Rauchen verringert Chance auf eine Schwangerschaft laut WHO-Studie, Das Wetter

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast: Israel hits back at sanctions on settlers
item.description:
The Israeli government takes retaliatory action after Britain, France and Canada impose sanctions on illegal settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel's Foreign Minister Gideon Saar has announced countermeasures including shutting the UK's consulate in East Jerusalem.

Also: fighting between US and Iranian forces flares again with the Americans striking Iranian oil tankers and Tehran targeting a US military base. Newly released files show that toxic air quality was being recorded in Manhattan soon after the 9/11 attacks even as officials played down health risks to the public. A global survey finds a dramatic decline in teenagers' performance at school in the digital era. British scientists are developing a screening test that can show whether a patient has a brain tumour by analysing their tears. And fans celebrate as the legendary TV show, Star Trek, turns sixty.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight. Get the news that matters, delivered twice a day on weekdays and daily at weekends, plus special bonus episodes reacting to urgent breaking stories. Follow or subscribe now and never miss a moment.
